title: Drop the Budget’s AI programme
name: Drop the Budget’s AI programme
headline: Drop the AI programme. Saves £0.1bn in 2029-30.
description: The Budget spends on AI security, adoption across the economy and strategically important UK AI capabilities, including the AI Security Institute. Switch this on to drop it.

baselinePolicy.text: Spending on AI security, adoption and UK AI capabilities is in the forecast (Table 6.1 line 31).

source.quote: AI security and resilience, including through an additional £120 million for the AI Security Institute

alreadyIncludes: Spending on AI security, adoption and UK AI capabilities is in the forecast (Table 6.1 line 31).

lines.title: Artificial Intelligence: Strengthen the UK’s AI security, accelerate adoption across the economy, and support strategically important UK AI capabilities

rawSource.note: Reversal on the spending side: the Treasury’s costing with the sign kept (a line that reduced borrowing is spending the reversal adds back; a line that cost money is spending the reversal saves).

caveats: The Treasury’s costing is on the OBR October 2026 forecast, the baseline used here. Effects before the start year are not applied: 2026-27 falls before any Budget of yours.

considerations.text: The Treasury’s scorecard figure is the Budget’s own costing of the measure, certified by the OBR as part of its October 2026 forecast.
